scope: Foundation Closure and selection of the next VSS product milestone.
decision: Foundation Closure is bounded. Select material development from an observable Film #1 gap; after its exit criteria, the next product milestone advances observable audiovisual production, preferably the first governed moving shot.
rationale: The current path reaches a reviewable still image but not observable audiovisual production. M10 closes at M10.7; M10.8 visual continuity is retired as a proposed direction.
constraints: Use existing strategic, constitutional, and Right to Pause review. Do not grant autonomous production authority or create a governor, agent framework, context platform, or cost subsystem. Delegated-agent authority must eventually have a bounded resource envelope and durable artifact-mediated context.
